question_en:
I am verifying the regular public advisories corresponding to the tropical cyclone track shown in the image. Starting from the initial time marked at the easternmost end of the black forecast center line: use the regular public advisory for that time at the starting point; for each subsequent forecast point, use the first regular public advisory issued after the time shown on the map, excluding intermediate advisories. For each advisory, read the system type from the title as well as `LOCATION`, `MAXIMUM SUSTAINED WINDS`, and `PRESENT MOVEMENT`; stop when the maximum sustained winds first reach or exceed 80 MPH; otherwise, proceed along the black center line to the next forecast point marked with a date and time. Please answer the following questions:
1. Which map times were verified in order? List "Map Time—System Type—LOCATION—MAXIMUM SUSTAINED WINDS—PRESENT MOVEMENT" according to the original advisory text.
2. How many different regular public advisories were verified in total?
3. At which map time did the process finally stop, and what was the maximum sustained wind speed in the corresponding advisory?

Answer Format: Please answer in numbered points (1) through (3); for Question 1, use a table to list the map times and the four advisory fields in order; for Question 2, state the total number of advisories in text; for Question 3, state the final map time and the corresponding maximum sustained wind speed in text.
answer:
(1)

| Verification Order | Map Time | System Type | LOCATION | MAXIMUM SUSTAINED WINDS | PRESENT MOVEMENT |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 11 PM Sun | Potential Tropical Cyclone FIVE | 14.1N 50.1W | 30 MPH / 45 KM/H | WNW OR 285 DEGREES AT 23 MPH / 37 KM/H |
| 2 | 8 PM Mon | Tropical Storm ERNESTO | 16.0N 59.6W | 40 MPH / 65 KM/H | W OR 275 DEGREES AT 25 MPH / 41 KM/H |
| 3 | 8 AM Tue | Tropical Storm ERNESTO | 16.9N 62.6W | 50 MPH / 85 KM/H | WNW OR 290 DEGREES AT 18 MPH / 30 KM/H |
| 4 | 8 PM Tue | Tropical Storm ERNESTO | 18.8N 65.3W | 65 MPH / 100 KM/H | NW OR 305 DEGREES AT 17 MPH / 28 KM/H |
| 5 | 8 AM Wed | Hurricane ERNESTO | 20.5N 67.6W | 75 MPH / 120 KM/H | NW OR 310 DEGREES AT 16 MPH / 26 KM/H |
| 6 | 8 PM Wed | Hurricane ERNESTO | 23.0N 68.9W | 80 MPH / 130 KM/H | NNW OR 330 DEGREES AT 16 MPH / 26 KM/H |

(2) A total of 6 different regular public advisories were verified.

(3) The process finally stopped at 8 PM Wed; the corresponding maximum sustained wind speed was 80 MPH / 130 KM/H.
